alt: Spirometry tracing (volume against time): quiet tidal breaths, then a maximal inspiration and a maximal expiration. Brackets on the right mark the four volumes - tidal volume (TV), inspiratory reserve volume (IRV), expiratory reserve volume (ERV), residual volume (RV) - and the capacities they sum into: inspiratory capacity (IC), functional residual capacity (FRC), vital capacity (VC) and total lung capacity (TLC). Axis words are in Polish: wdech = inspiration, wydech = expiration.
